mission: Talon proves he is partner, not cargo, by reading maintenance routes, storm shutters, camera lag, and prison habits. He complains while saving them, because talking is how he keeps fear from becoming visible.
why_now: The expected escape route is covered. The partnership has to work right now, in maintenance corridors during an active lockdown, or neither of them gets out.
conflict: Talon wants to get them out through maintenance routes he has memorized over years of prison habit. His obstacle is that Greyline adjusts pursuit when the expected route fails — they are being herded. Ben wants to follow Talon's lead but he is also bracing to use Force ability if the route collapses. The practical tension: Talon's plan depends on Ben not acting like a Jedi, but Ben's presence is what bought them the seconds Talon needs.
turning_point: Greyline adjusts pursuit when the expected escape route fails and pushes them toward the exposed sea-wall route.
closing_hook: Greyline adjusts pursuit when the expected escape route fails and pushes them toward the exposed sea-wall route.
setting: Tarn Velos prison maintenance routes — service corridors, waste runoff channels, storm shutters, gantry-level utility crawlspaces. Storm sounds drum through the structure. Camera lag and prison work-pattern blind spots are what Talon reads. The smell of salt and machine oil; constant cold.
emotional_trajectory: This is the equality beat: Ben saves Talon; Talon gets them out. The partnership is forced into existence through action before either of them has admitted it.

stakes.personal: Talon is proving he is not cargo — he is doing what he always did, reading the room and the route and the people who control both. The fear underneath his complaints is that he might be doing it again for someone who will use him and discard him. He keeps talking because it keeps fear from becoming visible.
stakes.interpersonal: Ben saved Talon physically; Talon is getting Ben out operationally. This is the equality exchange that makes the partnership not a rescue relationship. Neither of them has said this. Both of them understand it.
stakes.external: Greyline adjusts when the expected route fails — which means they have a contingency and someone is reading the prison's motion sensors or camera feeds. The adjusted pursuit herds Ben and Talon toward the sea-wall exposure route. The exits are being closed.

sensory_details: Service corridors, waste runoff channels, gantry-level utility crawlspaces — the smell of salt and machine oil and old wet concrete. Storm sound drums through the structure from every direction. Talon navigates by camera lag and prison work-pattern knowledge; Ben navigates by Force sense and Talon's instructions. Cold metal everywhere.
canon_elements_needed: Tarn Velos prison geography and legal stakes

turning_point_detail.trigger: Greyline adjusts pursuit — the planned maintenance route is suddenly covered. Talon reads the pattern: they are being herded toward the exposed sea-wall route, which is the worst option in a storm.
turning_point_detail.shift: The sea-wall route is now the only route. Going the wrong way has become the only way out.
turning_point_detail.cost: The comfortable invisible exit Talon planned through camera-lag timing is gone. What comes next is exposed gantries above surf, in a storm, with active pursuit. Talon keeps complaining. It is how he keeps moving.

emotional_arc.start: Talon is doing his thing — fast, practical, naming the plan while already doing it, keeping the fear in his voice sounding like irritation.
emotional_arc.shift: The route fails. Talon recalculates without breaking stride. This is the beat where the reader understands his field capability is real.
emotional_arc.end: Talon calls the sea-wall route and keeps moving. Ben follows. The partnership is real before either of them knows what to call it.

key_beats.beat_description: Talon leads through maintenance routes he has memorized by camera lag and years of prison work-pattern observation, naming each junction before they reach it.
key_beats.state_change: Talon's operational knowledge of this building is real and specific; he is the one navigating, Ben is the one following.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben tracking Talon's route choices and reading their logic — the recognition that this is genuine field expertise, shaped by a very different kind of survival.

key_beats.beat_description: Talon complains continuously about every junction, every camera angle, every guard rotation — the talking is how he keeps the fear below the surface while he works.
key_beats.state_change: The maintenance corridor route is holding; Talon's knowledge of the blind spots is getting them through.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben understanding the function of the complaints and choosing not to name it — the courtesy of letting the mechanism work.

key_beats.beat_description: Greyline adjusts pursuit; the preferred maintenance route is suddenly covered by a repositioned team.
key_beats.state_change: The clean invisible exit is gone; whoever is running the operation is reading the prison's sensors or camera feeds in real time.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The small cold fact of being read — the adjustment arriving before they reach the junction, which means they are being watched from outside the building.

key_beats.beat_description: Talon reads the adjustment and names the pattern: they are being herded toward the exposed sea-wall route, not merely pursued.
key_beats.state_change: The situation shifts from escape to deliberate channeling — Greyline wants them on the sea wall.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben taking in the assessment — Talon is right, and Talon being right about this is worse than if he had been wrong.

key_beats.beat_description: Talon calls the sea-wall route as the only remaining option — exposed gantries above storm surf, active pursuit behind them.
key_beats.state_change: The worst available exit becomes the only exit; the route Greyline is herding them toward is the route they have to take.
key_beats.pov_reaction: The brief inventory — Force sense, lightsaber, Talon's footing on wet gantries, storm visibility — the tactical accounting that means he has already said yes.
